shared_elements: schematic outline figures on a rock surface
rows of repeated small vertical elements (crew strokes / repeated signs)
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic outline figures organised into roughly horizontal registers, and both feature rows of repeated small vertical marks (crew strokes in A, a fringe/comb band in B), but this is a generic formal echo rather than shared iconography. A depicts almost exclusively boats with crew and a few animal-headed prows, while B depicts a menagerie of profile animals (long-necked birds, quadrupeds, a possible reptile) beneath a row of large sculpted heads; no specific motif or relationship is shared.
